name: Meta-QTS Hillsboro 2

timeline.event: First signs of site land clearing appear on satellite imagery.
Satellite imagery shows Building 3 and 4 cooling start to go on.

Satellite imagery shows Building 2 and 3 cooling nearing completion and Building 4 cooling install continues. We believe Building 1 is operational now due to the lack of construction equipment on or immediately around the building.

We believe Buildings 2, 3, and 4 are operational due to the absence of construction vehicles and completed parking lots/concrete around the facilities. There is also a vehicle presence in the parking lot similar to the level seen during…

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Meta-QTS Hillsboro 2: current power 180 MW; owner Meta.

explain: Meta-QTS Hillsboro 2 is an operating AI data center in Hillsboro, OR, owned by meta. Epoch AI estimates it draws 180 MW today and 243 MW when finished.
